title: Coupling Perception and Reasoning in Federated Multimodal Graph Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.00277v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Federated multimodal graph foundation models (GFMs) aim to adapt pretrained multimodal models to decentralized graph data, where each client owns a private multimodal graph and cannot share raw information. These models typically combine a multimodal Encoder that extracts semantic evidence from heterogeneous modalities and a graph neural network (GNN) that performs relational reasoning over graph structures. However, existing federated GFM adaptation methods mainly update graph-side modules while keeping the multimodal Encoder frozen, limiting adaptation to \emph{how information is propagated} while fixing \emph{what information is extracted}. Through empirical studies, we reveal that Encoder and GNN adaptations are not independent: Encoder adaptation is affected by graph relations, while cross-client module swapping reveals substantial pairing sensitivity between separately parameterized Encoder and GNN updates. translated_title: 联邦多模态图基础模型中感知与推理的耦合
translated_abstract: 联邦多模态图基础模型（GFMs）旨在将预训练的多模态模型适配到去中心化的图数据上，其中每个客户端拥有私有的多模态图，且无法共享原始信息。这类模型通常结合两个组件：从异构模态中提取语义证据的多模态编码器，以及在图结构上执行关系推理的图神经网络（GNN）。然而，现有的联邦GFM适配方法主要只更新图侧模块，而将多模态编码器保持冻结，这将适配范围局限于“信息如何传播”，而固定了“提取什么信息”。通过实证研究，我们揭示了编码器与GNN的适配并非相互独立：编码器的适配会受到图关系的影响，而跨客户端的模块交换实验表明，单独参数化的编码器与GNN更新之间存在显著的配对敏感性。受这一观察的启发……
tldr: 该论文通过实证研究揭示联邦多模态图基础模型中多模态编码器与图神经网络的适配相互耦合、并非独立，指出应联合适配感知与推理模块而非冻结编码器。
en_tdlr: This paper empirically reveals that multimodal encoder and GNN adaptations in federated multimodal graph foundation models are interdependent, arguing for coupled adaptation of perception and reasoning modules instead of freezing the encoder.
